name: askii
description: AI code assistant with style ( •_•)>⌐■-■ (⌐■_■) — ask, edit, agentic tasks, screen/browser control, commit messages, code review and AI notes, with your choice of LLM (ASKII Cloud, Ollama, LM Studio, OpenAI, Anthropic, opencode Go).
author: danisss9

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode ASKII Do is disabled, wikis are not rebuilt automatically, and workspace settings cannot change which files ASKII reads or which features run.

virtualWorkspaces.description: ASKII reads and writes workspace files on disk, so it needs a local (or remote) file system.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with ASKII
walkthroughs.description: Pick an LLM, ask your first question, run an agent task and see what is sent where.

steps.title: Choose your LLM
steps.description:
Pick a provider and models — local or cloud. API keys go to VS Code secret storage.
[Open Setup](command:askii.openSetup)

steps.title: Ask about your code
steps.description:
Select some code and ask a question — answers stream in with clickable file references.
[Ask ASKII](command:askii.askQuestion)

steps.title: Let ASKII do a task
steps.description:
The workspace agent explores and edits files — every write and command is confirmed, and you can undo the whole run.
[Run ASKII Do](command:askii.doTask)

steps.title: Know what is sent where
steps.description:
See which data each feature sends to your provider, and how to keep secrets out of inline features.
[Review inline exclusions](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22askii.inlineExcludeGlobs%22)

askii.llmPlatform.description: LLM platform to use for ASKII Ask, Edit, Do and code review (ollama, lmstudio, openai, anthropic, opencodego, or askiicloud)

askii.llmModel.description: Model id to use for ASKII Ask, Edit, Do and code review. Set to a model id supported by askii.llmPlatform (e.g. askii-smart, gpt-5-mini, claude-sonnet-4-6, glm-5.2, gemma4:e4b).

askii.llmInlinePlatform.description: LLM platform to use for ASKII inline suggestions, inline completion and git commit message generation.

askii.llmInlineModel.description: Model id to use for ASKII inline suggestions, inline completion and git commit message generation.

askii.llmVisionPlatform.description: LLM platform to use for ASKII Control (screen and browser) — needs a vision-capable model.

askii.llmVisionModel.description: Vision-capable model id to use for ASKII Control (screen and browser).

askii.ollamaUrl.description: URL of the Ollama API server

askii.lmStudioUrl.description: URL of the LM Studio API server

askii.openaiUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL (leave empty for api.openai.com). Use this for Azure OpenAI or other compatible APIs.

enumDescriptions: Show explanations enriched with matching context from your enabled wikis (docs and/or code)
askii.inlineHelperMode.description: Inline helper mode for code decorations

askii.doMaxRounds.description: Maximum number of interaction rounds for ASKII Do command

askii.doAutoConfirm.description: Automatically confirm file create/modify/delete actions in ASKII Do. Shell commands (run) and files that can make VS Code or git run code (.vscode/, .husky/, git hooks) are always confirmed.

askii.controlAutoConfirm.markdownDescription: Run ASKII Control screen and browser actions (mouse, keyboard, page navigation) **without asking first**. Separate from `askii.doAutoConfirm`.

askii.formatAfterEdit.description: Automatically format files after ASKII Edit or ASKII Do creates/modifies them

askii.browserHeadless.description: Launch the Puppeteer browser in headless mode for ASKII Control browser mode (set to false to show the browser window)

askii.chromePath.description: Path to a Chromium-based browser executable for ASKII Control browser mode (e.g. C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe or C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe). Leave empty to auto-detect Chrome, Edge, Chromium or Brave.

askii.wikiEnabled.description: Enable wiki RAG context for Ask / Edit / Do commands. Requires askii.wikiPath to be set and the wiki to be indexed via ASKII: Reload Wikis.

askii.wikiPath.description: Path to folder containing .md documentation files used for wiki RAG context. Run 'ASKII: Reload Wikis' after changing this or updating the docs.

askii.wikiAutoReload.description: Automatically rebuild and reload the wiki index when the extension starts. Requires askii.wikiEnabled and askii.wikiPath to be configured.

askii.codeWikiEnabled.description: Enable code wiki — a vector index over workspace code (code files only) used as retrieval context for Ask / Edit / Do. Runs the embeddinggemma2 model locally (first index build downloads it once to ~/.askii/models); build the index via ASKII: Reload Wikis.

askii.codeWikiAutoReload.description: Automatically rebuild the code wiki index when the extension starts. Requires askii.codeWikiEnabled.

askii.inlineCompletionEnabled.description: Enable ASKII inline code completion (Copilot-style ghost text in the editor; Tab to accept, Esc to dismiss).

enumDescriptions: Trigger after 1200ms — fewer, more deliberate suggestions
askii.inlineCompletionEagerness.description: How eagerly ASKII requests inline completions. Controls the debounce delay and context window size.

askii.commitMessageInstructions.description: Path to a .md (or .txt) file with custom instructions for the commit message generator (injected as the system prompt, appended to the built-in rules). May be absolute or relative to the workspace root. Leave empty to use the built-in prompt.

enumDescriptions: Generate a concise subject with an optional short body
Generate a fuller message with more descriptive context
askii.commitMessageStyle.description: Preferred output style for ASKII Git commit messages (OneLiner, Brief, or Descriptive).

askii.noteReminderSound.description: Play a sound when an ASKII Note reminder fires.

askii.noteSnoozeMinutes.description: Minutes to snooze an ASKII Note reminder when the user clicks 'Snooze' on the notification.

askii.requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time in seconds for one LLM request before it is cancelled (0 = no limit). Applies to every feature and provider.

askii.maxOutputTokens.markdownDescription: Maximum output tokens per LLM reply. `0` uses each provider's default (Anthropic needs an explicit limit and gets 8192). When a reply hits the limit, ASKII Do discards it and asks the model for smaller steps instead of writing a truncated file.

askii.inlineExcludeGlobs.markdownDescription: Glob patterns of files whose content is **never** sent to the LLM by inline completion and inline explanations (secrets, keys, credentials). Matched against the file path.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile
scripts.lint: eslint src common test cli/index.ts media
